# System Architecture Blueprint

This repository is currently undergoing Stage 1 of the Transformation Pipeline (Auditor Architect v1).

## Constraints
- ZERO-NEW-ROUTES INVARIANT: No new routes may be created. We exclusively refine existing routes.
- SWISS LIGHT MODE DOCTRINE: We use the OKLCH color space for maximum light and clarity. No dark mode.
- NEXT.JS 16+ PARADIGMS: Server Component supremacy, asynchronous params/searchParams, use cache, React 19 form actions.

All architectural modifications are strictly guided by the generated `.jules/revolution-plan.json`.
